explication: This repository is a catalog of independent, white-label generative-AI products and tools, not one integrated application. Its principal SaaS pattern is user authentication, credit-funded AI work, asynchronous result handling, and persistent job history, with Stripe billing as a separate purchase path. The tree also includes a local-inference studio and a YouTube-shorts pipeline. Relationships for the shared SaaS pattern are documented in the README; several product branches are represented by their listed route paths because their implementations were not sampled.
